6	# Write Memory
7	
8	Writes a memory file to the workspace-specific memory directory derived from `$PWD`. This is the only path the harness injects into future runs of the same task workspace.
9	
10	## Critical rule
11	
12	**Never delegate memory writes to a subagent (Agent tool).** The subagent cannot know the spawning agent's `$PWD`, so it will write to the wrong path — typically the space-root memory, which is never injected into workspace runs.
13	
14	Write memory directly using the `Write` and `Edit` tools.
15	
16	## Step 1 — compute the memory path
17	
18	```bash
19	MEMORY_DIR="/root/.claude/projects/$(pwd | sed 's|[^a-zA-Z0-9-]|-|g')/memory"
20	echo "$MEMORY_DIR"
21	mkdir -p "$MEMORY_DIR"
